summary: A door volunteer says who they are, which office the candidate wants, and keeps the pitch to a few short points.
realLife: A training script for door volunteers has them name themselves, say they volunteer for the campaign, state the office sought, give no more than three message points, then ask for support.
inGame: volunteer-offered record; the door scene's opening line

turns.turn: The volunteer runs long and loses the voter
turns.writesBack: the voter edges back and the door closes early

turns.turn: The volunteer stops at the ask and listens
turns.writesBack: the voter names what matters to them
